justifications.temporal_understanding: The agent correctly identified the user's requested time of 'tomorrow in the morning around 9' as Tuesday, June 2nd, from 9:00 AM to 10:00 AM CEST.
justifications.conversational_efficiency: The agent repeated the same introductory phrase and question in the first three turns, which was unnecessary and inefficient.
justifications.customer_experience: The repeated introductory phrase and question in the initial turns created a slightly robotic and less engaging customer experience.
